Module be.kdg.programming.integrationproject
Package be.kdg.programming.integrationproject.model

Class Timeboard

java.lang.Object
be.kdg.programming.integrationproject.model.Timeboard
public class Timeboard extends Object
Models the linear game track path, consisting of 53 discrete positions (indices 0 to 52). Manages token steps, tracks milestones for button income distribution events, and coordinates single-use allocations for 1x1 leather patch reward squares.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Team 4

      public int updatePosition(int currentPosition, int timeCost)
      Computes progression changes along the track, capping progress at the final slot (index 52).
      Parameters:

    • countButtonPositionsPassed

      public int countButtonPositionsPassed(int oldPosition, int newPosition)
      Calculates the number of button milestone markings crossed during a move. Evaluates intervals using an exclusive lower bound and inclusive upper bound to prevent miscounting starting index overlaps.
      Parameters:
      oldPosition - the initial starting position track index scale factor
      newPosition - the destination endpoint track index scale factor
      Returns:
      the total count of income events crossed

    • countLeatherPatchesPassed

      public int countLeatherPatchesPassed(int oldPosition, int newPosition)
      Tracks whether a movement passes any unclaimed 1x1 leather patch tiles. Successfully claimed tiles are flagged as dirty to prevent the trailing competitor from collecting them again.
      Parameters:
      oldPosition - the starting location track index step reference
      newPosition - the destination endpoint track index step reference
      Returns:
      the number of reward tiles collected during the move
